rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for flattering words or praise used to influence someone.

example.english: That blandishment was simply meant to get me to recommend him for a job.
example.traditional: 佢講嗰句恭維話，無非想我幫佢介紹份工。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 go2 geoi3 gung1 wai4 waa6 mou4 fei1 soeng2 ngo5 bong1 keoi5 gaai3 siu6 fan6 gung1

rows.note: Use this for especially sweet or romantic-sounding words intended to win someone over.

example.english: His blandishment toward his girlfriend kept her smiling all day.
example.traditional: 佢對女朋友講嘅甜言蜜語，搞到人哋成日笑。
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 neoi5 pang4 jau5 gong2 ge3 tim4 jin4 mat6 jyu5 gaau2 dou3 jan4 dei6 seng4 jat6 siu3

rows.note: Use this when the flattering words sound glib, artful, or deliberately manipulative.

example.english: Don’t be fooled by that blandishment; you’ll be in trouble once you sign the contract.
example.traditional: 唔好畀佢嗰番花言巧語呃到，你簽咗約就弊喇。
example.jyutping: m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 go2 faan1 faa1 jin4 haau2 jyu5 ngaak1 dou3 nei5 cim1 zo2 joek3 zau6 bai6 laa3
